Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to share some feedback regarding recent observations of your behavior in the workplace. We have received several reports indicating that your conduct has not aligned with our company’s core values.

We value a respectful and professional work environment for everyone, and we believe that addressing this matter promptly is important for maintaining that standard. We are confident in your ability to make the necessary adjustments and look forward to seeing an immediate improvement in your interactions with colleagues.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this further or if there are any support resources you might need.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
